no-disallowed-attr.reason: The href is Alpine-bound (:href), invisible to the static mustache parser — the linter sees an <a> without href, where target/rel are disallowed. At runtime the anchor always carries a real external href.

require-owned-elements.reason: Alpine <template x-for> content is parsed into a DocumentFragment and never enters the accessibility tree, so the required parent/child role pair cannot exist in the static DOM.
